Tarnholm Frequency Authority, notice 2025-41

The Authority adopted a component-part authorization rule for imported data-center equipment. A ban on foreign optical transceivers remains a draft.

Under the rule, each radio component inside imported equipment needs its own authorization before the equipment can be sold.

Comments on the draft transceiver ban are open until the end of the year.
